data.one_liner: A swiper and carousel widget for Flutter with multiple layouts and infinite loop.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable swiper/carousel widget supporting infinite loops, multiple layouts like stack and tinder, pagination, and autoplay capabilities.
use_when: You need a carousel or swiper component in your Flutter app
You require custom layouts like stack or tinder cards
You need infinite scrolling loops for image or content banners
avoid_when: You are looking for official material widgets without third-party dependencies
You require complex state management solutions
strengths: Supports multiple layouts including default, stack, and tinder
Infinite loop and autoplay features included
Compatible with Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Documentation is sparse and partly in Chinese
Relies on a port of an older package adapted for null safety
